review.official:
Originally a
Sargon
soldier, Spot took the initiative and came to
Rhodes Island
seeking employment himself. After passing the examination battery, he was assigned to
Op Reserve Team A6
.
He has a lot of experience as guard; and serves as the defensive specialist on the team.

files.description:
Imaging test for this Operator showed blurry outline of internal organs with visible unusual dark spots. Unusually high concentration of Originium particles were present in his circulation, indicating signs of infection and confirming him as infected at this stage. 

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 3% 
Crystallization visible on surface of body, with many symptoms of Oripathy difficult to spot due to skin and hair color. 

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.30u/L 
Infection is currently spreading at a constant rate. Regular observation and treatment required.

A member of Reserve Op Team A6 who used to be a Sargon soldier. 
He rarely speaks and has little reason to. On the rare occasion he does open his mouth, he tends to be brutally direct. Among the ostentatious members of Team A6, he is truly the odd man out.

A fan of superheroes and pulp action, Spot loves to read comics and has an impressive collection. 
He has filled a whole shelf with his comic books, and other Operators often borrow them from him.

Although Sargon is a developed country with no shortage of modern entertainment in its cities, the Sargonians always seem a bit withdrawn.
Spot himself seemingly has no interest in anything other than comics and fashion. Every once in a while, he will ask Orchid to give him a Sargonian hairstyle.

Spot's personality is largely the product of a stoic family. 
Sargonian military families have no patience for laziness. Unwilling to conform to his family's wishes, he became closed off, aggressive, and eventually ran away from home.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Work's kinda like a trap, and you just fling yourself into it.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: I don't talk much 'cause I don't want to. Not 'cause I'm looking down on anyone.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: What did Midnight do this time? Did he finally end up in Medical after hitting on one too many ladies in the hallway? No? Too bad.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Got something, Doctor? I could probably lend a hand. But I'd rather not eat up too much of my time. I got a lot of comics to read.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I know I speak a little too bluntly sometimes, but I always get my work done. It's not like I got professional pride or anything, I just can't respect somebody who doesn't finish his work.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Rhodes Island is a strange place. The people here just say whatever they're thinking, and somebody's always there to help when someone needs it.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Reserve Op Team A6 is a real diverse crowd. We have Lady Stinky-face, Miss Lacking-self-confrol, Narcissist Kun, and a little walking time bomb. But still, I do think I can trust them. They work hard, even if they don't show it.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: I used to live free and easy like everyone else at Rhodes Island, but my family thought I was a freak. This place may be a freakshow, but at least everyone's happy, and that's pretty good.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Can I go back to my room now?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Hi, I'm Spot from Operation Reserve Team A6. My job is to protect the other troublemakers on my team, I guess.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: I've seen this battle before. Bad guys got their asses kicked.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: I'm gonna work twice as hard. I'll bump it up from a 0.1 to a 0.2, I think.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: I won't ask about the meaning of this mission then.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I wanna get back to my dorm.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Got it.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Save us a lot of time if you just surrender.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Whatever you say.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Doesn't matter to me.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Alright then.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Yeah, yeah, fine.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Hey, catch.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Don't see any harm in this.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: So many weaknesses.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Holding this shield is tiring, pal.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Been through an easy battle, you say? Then better do it all over again.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: With hard work, even an idiot can get the job done.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Perfection is for suckers, you know.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Relax, you're doing fine.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Yeah sure.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Ah.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: If you keep petting me like that, my hair's gonna get tangled.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: It's the start of a new year. If you were expecting anything to change on its own with time, then stop dreaming. Really changing yourself takes way more effort than that. If you can manage it, do it.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Hey Doctor...

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday. I don't have anything decent, but you can have this old set of limited-edition comics. I always dreamed of becoming a hero when I was little, but I learned the hard way that it takes all my effort just to stay alive. Don't worry, the comics are still good.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Someone like me can't exactly say I fully embrace Rhodes Island's ideals from the bottom of my heart. I only raise my shield to protect the troublemakers of A6, that's all. Doctor, let's try and survive this troublesome land together.
